title: Mariner 4 flies past
summary: First close pictures of Mars: 21 images of a cratered, Moon-like surface.
summary_zh: 首次近距离拍摄火星：21幅照片显示布满陨坑、酷似月球的地表。

title: Mars 3 lands
summary: The Soviet lander is the first to touch down softly, but falls silent after about 20 seconds.
summary_zh: 苏联着陆器首次实现软着陆，但约20秒后失去信号。

title: Mariner 9 orbits Mars
summary: The first spacecraft to orbit another planet waits out a global dust storm, then maps the giant volcanoes and the canyon later named after it.
summary_zh: 首个环绕其他行星的航天器，等全球沙尘暴平息后，绘出巨型火山和日后以它命名的大峡谷。

title: Viking 1 lands
summary: The first fully successful landing. It sends the first pictures from the surface and tests the soil for life.
summary_zh: 首次完全成功的着陆，发回首张地表照片，并检测土壤中的生命迹象。

title: Viking 2 lands
summary: Lands on the northern plains and records frost on the ground in winter.
summary_zh: 降落在北方平原，冬季拍到地面结霜。

title: Pathfinder and Sojourner
summary: Bounces down on airbags and releases Sojourner, the first wheeled rover on Mars.
summary_zh: 靠气囊弹跳着陆，放出火星上第一辆轮式漫游车旅居者号。

title: Mars Polar Lander lost
summary: Contact is lost during descent near the south pole.
summary_zh: 在南极附近下降时失去联系。

title: Beagle 2 goes silent
summary: The British lander never calls home; in 2015 orbiter images show it landed but its panels did not fully open.
summary_zh: 英国着陆器始终没有发回信号；2015年轨道照片显示它已着陆，但太阳能板未完全展开。

title: Spirit lands in Gusev
title_zh: 勇气号登陆古谢夫陨坑
summary: The rover finds silica-rich soil that points to ancient hot springs.
summary_zh: 漫游车发现富含二氧化硅的土壤，指向古代温泉。

title: Opportunity lands at Meridiani
title_zh: 机遇号登陆子午线高原
summary: Finds 'blueberries' of hematite and layered rock laid down in water; drives 45 km over 14 years.
summary_zh: 发现赤铁矿“蓝莓”和水中沉积的层状岩石，14年间行驶45公里。

title: Phoenix digs up ice
summary: The arctic lander scrapes the soil and watches white water ice sublimate.
summary_zh: 北极着陆器刮开土壤，看着白色的水冰升华消失。

title: Curiosity lands in Gale
summary: Lowered by a rocket 'sky crane', the car-sized rover finds an ancient lake that could have supported life.
summary_zh: 由火箭“空中吊车”放下，这辆汽车大小的漫游车发现了可能宜居的古湖泊。

title: Schiaparelli crashes
summary: The European test lander misjudges its height and falls.
summary_zh: 欧洲试验着陆器误判高度而坠毁。

title: InSight listens for marsquakes
summary: Records more than 1,300 marsquakes and measures the size of the planet's core.
summary_zh: 记录到1300多次火星地震，测出火星核的大小。

title: Perseverance lands in Jezero
title_zh: 毅力号登陆耶泽罗陨坑
summary: Lands in an old river delta to collect rock samples for a future return to Earth.
summary_zh: 降落在古河流三角洲，采集岩石样本以备日后送回地球。

title: Ingenuity flies
summary: The small helicopter makes the first powered, controlled flight on another planet, and flies 72 times.
summary_zh: 小直升机完成首次地外动力受控飞行，共飞行72次。

title: Zhurong lands in Utopia
title_zh: 祝融号登陆乌托邦平原
summary: China's first rover lands at the first attempt and studies buried layers with radar.
summary_zh: 中国首辆火星车首次尝试即成功着陆，用雷达探测地下分层。
